entries.text: Movement Speed Doctrines — do not use.

doctrines.note: Veterancy: Top-line or Mix-line (bot until +25% rage, rest top). Berserkers have a 3.08s cooldown on skill 2 (Berserker Assault); with the 20% CD reduction unique doctrine it drops to 2s. Combo per OP: if going for free DPS, insta-rage gives best DPS, but the real combo is press 2 (Battle Madness) before engaging, instantly press 1 after to cancel it, press 2 when reaching target, then spam press 3 (Rage) so you rage with max DMG-reduction passive, then keep pressing 2 once then 3 while fighting. Tips & Tricks: keep the defence passive (Battle Madness) up by playing 2 into charge into 1 into 2 into 3, repeat the 2-3 pattern; a 'fast combo' variant is 2 in void before engaging, then 2-1-2-3 to use Frenzy at max stacks. Edit timestamp (2026-05-28) pre-dates the 2026-06-25 Chaos patch anchor; doctrine/build guidance flagged for revalidation (Berserkers is not on the 13-unit Chaos shortlist, so staleAsOfPatch not forced, noting pre-patch authorship per instructions).
